## Codebase Architecture Map

This is a **3D interactive portfolio website** built with Three.js, styled as a virtual garage where a robot navigates between project stations.

### Main Entry Point

- **`index.html`** — loads all JS modules via `<script type="module">` tags in dependency order
- **`js/main.js`** — application orchestrator that initializes all subsystems and coordinates the game loop

### Five Most Interconnected Modules

| Rank | Module | Imported By | Role |
|------|--------|-------------|------|
| 1 | `js/core/constants.js` | **25 files** | Central configuration hub (dimensions, colors, speeds, positions) |
| 2 | `js/core/materials.js` | **23 files** | Material factory for consistent cel-shaded/toon aesthetic |
| 3 | `js/entities/station.js` | **20 files** | Interactive station factory + proximity detection system |
| 4 | `js/systems/collision.js` | **10 files** | AABB collision detection for movement and boundaries |
| 5 | `js/core/loop.js` | **8 files** | Game loop with delta-time and callback registry |

### Data Flow: Input → Core Logic

```
User Input (WASD/E/Escape)
  → systems/controls.js    (captures keystate, calculates desired movement)
  → systems/collision.js   (validates position against boundaries + objects)
  → entities/robot.js      (updates robot position, triggers animations)
  → systems/camera.js      (lerps camera to follow robot)
  → main.js interaction()  (checks proximity to stations via station.js)
  → [User presses E]       → systems/ui.js shows modal with data/content.js
  → core/loop.js           (executes all registered animation callbacks)
  → core/engine.js         (Three.js render pass + FXAA post-processing)
```

### Architecture Layers

```
DATA          data/content.js (work history, skills, certifications)
CORE CONFIG   constants.js → materials.js → engine.js → loop.js
ENTITIES      garage.js, robot.js, station.js, brokk/revojam/loanscout/web3 stations, 14+ decorations
SYSTEMS       controls.js, collision.js, animation.js, audio.js, ui.js, minimap.js, debug.js
ORCHESTRATOR  main.js (initializes everything, registers loop callbacks, manages lifecycle)
```

The architecture follows a clean **layered pattern** — configuration feeds into core engine, entities are built from core primitives, systems operate on entities, and `main.js` ties it all together. The game loop in `loop.js` is the heartbeat: every frame it fires registered callbacks for movement, collision, animation, audio, and minimap updates, then renders via the Three.js composer.
